invariants: The control stage authenticates the signed package and resolves all 27 RestorationBinding records.
The import stage declares all 27 restored disk files as inputs and publishes one named output per binding.
Each source and output matches the binding byte count and SHA-256.
The capacity check runs before VIPER captures a disk input and the retained stage receipt repeats the same calculation.
The archive plan remains available as the identity-checked recovery route.

findings.counterexample: The initial tests changed binding metadata but never changed a preserved-disk file.
findings.repair: Add a source-identity counterexample that reaches the byte check and proves copying never starts.
